prompt: What was the difference in receiving yards from 2022 and 2023 for number 11 on the 49ers? Calculate the same 2022/2023 difference for the closest ranked WR for number 11's draft class and compare their numbers.
answer:
No. 11 on the 49ers was **Brandon Aiyuk**, a member of the 2020 draft class.

Using receiving yards and calculating **2023 minus 2022**:

| Receiver | 2022 yards | 2023 yards | Difference |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Brandon Aiyuk** | 1,015 | 1,342 | **+327** |
| **Justin Jefferson** — the closest-ranked 2020-class WR to Aiyuk | 1,809 | 1,074 | **−735** |

Thus, Aiyuk gained **327 more receiving yards** in 2023, while Jefferson had **735 fewer**. Aiyuk’s year-over-year change was therefore **1,062 yards better** than Jefferson’s.
